description: Saves the given answer to one open question and applies it to every application asking it; those applications then continue. The answer is stored exactly as given, as the user's own words or the option they chose. Returns the applications answered and those now ready to continue. Sends nothing.

answer.description: The user's own answer, or the exact option they picked.

batch_id.description: The question group from list_pending_questions the question belongs to.

idempotency_key.description: Repeating a call with the same key and arguments returns its first result instead of acting again.

question_index.description: Which question of that group to answer, as list_pending_questions numbers it.

name: answer_question

answered.description: The applications the answer was applied to.

banked.description: How many reusable answers the answer was stored as.

profile_field.description: The profile field the answer was saved to, when it is a fact the profile keeps.

ready.description: The applications left with nothing to ask, now ready to go on.

title: Answer an employer question
